description:
We are a team of students interested in space exploration, engineering, physics, technology. Last year, we participated in a space hackathon, where we developed Infinity Nomads, a project focused on designing a sustainable space station near Europa, one of Jupiter's moons. We researched energy production, radiation protection, life support systems, and the challenges of living in space.

Our team has experience in scientific research, robotics, mathematics, data analysis, engineering design.
